hero.tagline: From 2016 to 2046, walking a generation of women into programming
hero.title: Building a bridge across the divide
hero.subtitle: Coding Girls Club · 程序媛汇 — building a bridge between women and programming.
hero.description: Founded in 2016, 程序媛汇 (Coding Girls Club) is a nonprofit coding community helping women enter and stay in tech. 2046 is the deadline we set for ourselves: thirty years of doing this properly — year after year, starting with a class, an event, a peer to turn to for help.
hero.quote: “Our mission is digital empowerment for women, and we pursue it with humble persistence.”
hero.stats: By 2021, we had reached 10 cities, run 50+ offline workshops, visited 17 universities, and accompanied 4000+ learners alongside 1000+ coaches.

media.title: Press & recognition
media.description: Moments recorded, studied, and recognized along the way.

honors: Selected for the UNDP “Tech for Good” project casebook (2018)
